text: Describe an app in natural language and Replit generates production-ready code for it
quote: Describe and publish your project. Replit writes production-ready code, evolves it, and stays out of your way.

text: Built-in authentication is automatically provisioned by the Agent with no separate signup or OAuth key copying
quote: Both are provisioned by Agent — no separate dashboard signup, no copy-pasting of OAuth keys.

text: A database can be added with zero setup so app data persists
quote: Built-in services with zero setup- Authentication, Database, Hosting, and Monitoring, enabling you to build fully scalable apps easily and securely from day one.

text: Apps can be enhanced with AI and 100+ integrations like OpenAI, Stripe, and Google Workspace
quote: Enhance your apps with AI and 100+ integrations. Connect to OpenAI, Stripe, Google Workspace, and more in minutes.

text: Security controls including SSO/SAML, SOC 2 compliance, admin controls, and app screening keep published apps safe
quote: Security controls: SSO/SAML, SOC 2, and admin controls. Screening and secure services keep apps safe.

text: A visual design space lets you explore and tweak designs, then apply them directly to your app
quote: Introducing a new space that allows you to explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app.

text: Agent Modes let you choose the balance of included allowance, credits, and capability before each request
quote: Agent Modes let you choose the balance between included allowance, credits, and capability before you send a request.

text: Publishing creates a stable production deployment running at its own URL
quote: Publishing creates a **production deployment**: a stable, shareable version of your app that runs at its own URL.

text: Published apps can be made public and accessible to anyone with the link
quote: **Public** makes the app available to anyone with the link.

text: A published app's URL can be swapped for a custom domain you own
quote: Move Velocity from velocity.replit.app to velocityrentals.com.

text: Replit Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources via MCP, including a curated catalog or custom servers added by URL
quote: Replit Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

text: Teammates can be invited into a project and each can start their own Agent threads while collaborating together
quote: Invite teammates to your project and build together — each person can start new threads with Agent while working on the same project.

text: A design template's selected frame can be turned into a functional website by the Agent, preserving visual design and working navigation
quote: Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.

text: You can test a built site in a live Preview before publishing it
quote: Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.

text: Published apps include tools to monitor app status and view web analytics
quote: Publishing includes tools to monitor your published app status and view web analytics.

text: Once a service is connected, you can ask Replit to pull relevant context, answer questions, or complete tasks using that data in the same conversation
quote: Connect a service, then ask Replit to find relevant context, answer a question, or help complete a task in the same conversation.

text: Published apps can be restricted with a shared password or limited to invited people/groups instead of being fully public
quote: Public makes the app available to anyone with the link... Invite only limits access to the people or groups you select.

text: Agent automatically provisions separate Development and Production environments
quote: Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.

text: You can start building on the web, in a Desktop App, or in a Mobile App
quote: Start on the web, in the Desktop App, or in the Mobile App.

text: You can begin a project with a conversation to ask questions, research ideas, and document a plan before building
quote: Start with a conversation. Ask questions, research ideas, and document your plan.

text: Visitors to a published app can send feedback via an enabled feedback widget
quote: You can also enable the feedback widget so visitors can send feedback from the published app.
